claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Galantamine is a reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor with nicotinic allosteric modulation; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is not expected to produce meaningful cytotoxicity in cancer cell lines, as its pharmacology is neurospecific and antiproliferative/cytotoxic effects are only reported at much higher concentrations.
